svg.text: Startup reconciliation — recovering from a crash mid-pipeline
Quick overview · follow 01 → 07 · full detail in ml-flow-08-startup-reconciliation-detailed.svg

g.text: Once, at FastAPI startup, after the predictor is initialized
orphaned runs, feedback reservations, activation state
Every sweep is wrapped in its own try/except
The manifest + bundle files as ground truth, never a bare status field alone
reconcile_orphaned_runs treats both statuses identically for orphan detection — a run stuck in either one,
whose runId no longer matches the current lock, is resolved as failed.

svg.text: Every decision here is re-derived from the manifest and bundle files, never from trusting a MongoDB status field in isolation.
